title: Native-Hosted Gridline Production Consumption Seam
released_boundary: NativeHostedGridlineProductionSurface: the macOS WKWebView host loads the current production Gridline frontend from deterministic bundled assets, with no implicit fixture execution and no navigation outside the allowed bundled asset root.
consumer_purpose: A later Connected Studio Integration lane can wire O0 live gateway transport and T1-safe publication preview into an actual native-hosted production frontend without repairing asset drift or fixture contamination first.
summary: T0 closes three material defects in the production consumption seam: (1) S1's claim that fixture scripts do not execute in production was false — the hard-coded <script src="js/fixtures/"> tags loaded and executed before the inline removal script ran; T0 replaces them with conditional createElement-based injection that only loads fixtures in explicit fixture mode. (2) The native bundled GridlineFrontend assets in macos/RigRelayShell/Sources/RigRelayShell/Resources/GridlineFrontend/ held a stale pre-S1 frontend copy without the protocol adapter, keyboard navigation, or S1 HTML structure; T0 syncs the bundle deterministically from the canonical frontend/desktop/ source via scripts/sync_gridline_frontend.sh. (3) WKWebView navigation policy allowed any file:// URL classified as .other before checking containment, and used vulnerable string-prefix containment; T0 replaces it with standardized URL path containment that refuses out-of-root and remote URLs unconditionally.

defects_repaired.title: Production fixture script execution
defects_repaired.falsified: Scripts with src attribute execute synchronously. The inline removal script ran after fixtures had already populated window.__P0_FIXTURES__. Claim was false.
defects_repaired.fix: Replaced hard-coded <script src="js/fixtures/..."> tags with conditional createElement-based injection inside a mode-check block. In production mode, zero fixture scripts appear in the DOM source and no fixture JavaScript ever executes.

defects_repaired.title: Bundled frontend divergence from canonical source
defects_repaired.prior_state: macos/.../GridlineFrontend/index.html was a different (older) frontend without adapter.js, keyboardNav.js, or the S1 HTML structure. Bundled app.js was a pre-S1 version without GridlineAdapter integration.
defects_repaired.fix: Deterministic rsync from canonical frontend/desktop/ to the SPM .copy resource target. Added scripts/sync_gridline_frontend.sh for future parity verification. Bundle now passes --check-only parity check.

defects_repaired.title: WebKit local navigation not fully contained
defects_repaired.prior_claim: Navigation policy restricted to file:// URLs within allowed directory (S0 audit)
defects_repaired.falsified: The decidePolicyFor handler allowed ANY file:// URL with navigationType == .other without containment check, and used raw path.hasPrefix which is vulnerable to sibling-prefix bypass.
defects_repaired.fix: Removed the unrestricted .other bypass. Uses URL.standardizedFileURL.path containment with hasPrefix(allowedPath + "/") to defeat sibling-prefix attacks. Blocks all remote URLs before file containment check.

bundle_parity.mechanism: scripts/sync_gridline_frontend.sh performs deterministic rsync from frontend/desktop/ to the SPM .copy resource target

deferred_seams.reason: Backend gateway WebSocket/HTTP transport is deferred. The native host boots the production frontend but has no live backend connectivity.
